title: ServerPinUpdateEvent
description: A message was pinned or unpinned. Scope everyone goes to every member; scope me (an own pin, or a pin for everyone hidden or shown again for you) only to your own sessions. Load GET /chats/{chat_id}/pins again, or apply the change: pinned adds the message to your pins, unpinned removes it. For scope everyone, unpinned may leave your own pin of the message, so reload in that case.

pinned_message_count.description: Chat.pinned_message_count for the recipient after the change.
